tidbit: Did you know… about 9,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google's Gemini 4 Argon leads in professional workflows, reported by Parametric Architecture, with 14 of 19 benchmark wins and one million token context.
U.S. states reached a child safety accord as chatbot use by teens surges, confirmed by The Seattle Times, raising concerns about mental health and development.
Sam Altman breaks with Anthropic on artificial intelligence regulation, reported by TradingView, saying the world must accept some bad things as benefits outweigh harms.
Google limits Gemini access by tier starting October 9, confirmed by Mashable India, with free users getting only Flash-Lite.
Gartner urges CISOs to act by 2026 on artificial intelligence, deepfakes, and quantum risks, reported by IT Voice Media.
Free every hour.
